mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies with a temperature of 78 degrees at the Verona Area High School, and the moon is currently in a waxing crescent phase.

The Verona Senior Center is currently looking for volunteers to support their services. Applicants must commit to at least two shifts per month and will need to complete a background check for roles involving interaction with seniors.

We have a busy weekend ahead. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy live music at several local spots including Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
On Friday, August 8, the Verona Police Department assisted the Dane County Sheriffs Office with a burglary investigation where a drone successfully located a suspect hiding in a corn field.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle. Culvers is open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
